verse.verse_1: Proclaim (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), “I take refuge of the One Who creates the Daybreak.”
verse.verse_2: “From the evil of His entire creation.”
verse.verse_3: “And from the evil of the matter that darkens when it sets.”
verse.verse_4: “And from the evil of the witches who blow into knots.”
verse.verse_5: “And from the evil of the envier when he is envious of me.”
